object_description: parallel classroom wing with stepped volumes linking two site levels
design_condition: A classroom wing parallel to the street forms a respectful lateral edge, connects the upper and lower levels, and creates an esplanade and sequence of open spaces between the existing buildings and the surrounding landscape.

positive.statement: The placement creates an esplanade with a view of the expansive landscape.

position.rationale: The broad open strip beside the parallel wing is clearly visible in plan.

positive.statement: The staircase-like classroom arrangement creates a natural transition to the lower-level uses.

position.rationale: Stepped massing and changing levels are visible along the principal classroom wing.

positive.statement: The classroom wing oscillates interestingly between building structure and designed landscape, giving the complex surprising spaciousness.

position.rationale: The linear wing visibly alternates with open landscape, producing a spacious edge condition.

positive.statement: The outdoor spaces provide break areas, outdoor classrooms, and a grandstand for varied activities.

position.target: break areas, outdoor classrooms, and grandstand
position.rationale: Outdoor activity spaces are anchored in the open zone between the wing and surrounding volumes.

positive.statement: The open-space design impresses with clear zoning and differentiation in close dialogue with the school rooms.

position.rationale: Distinct open zones are visible around the linear building and connecting level changes.

positive.statement: The various paths and shortcuts create a high degree of permeability.

position.rationale: The circulation anchor follows the open-space sequence alongside and across the wing.

positive.statement: The positioning of the new building volumes is very harmonious and respectful toward the existing buildings.

position.rationale: The parallel stepped volumes are clearly separated and respectfully positioned in the model.

positive.statement: The design naturally connects the different levels and gives the complex vision and spaciousness.

position.rationale: Elevation views show the wing bridging visibly different horizontal levels.

positive.statement: The project generates its identity from the location.

position.rationale: The distinctive parallel, stepped placement provides the model anchor for location-derived identity.

negative.statement: The rows of trees on the upper level and the street space are not convincing.

position.target: rows of trees and street space
position.rationale: The upper street-facing edge is used to approximate the criticized trees and street space.

negative.statement: The division of the childcare rooms over three storeys is not convincing.

position.rationale: Childcare rooms are approximated within the upper portion of the stepped building.

negative.statement: Long, narrow, and dark corridors connect the rooms, while the small studio zones degenerate into work niches.

position.target: long narrow corridors and studio zones
position.rationale: Interior circulation is placed along the elongated classroom wing, where its narrowness is implied.

negative.statement: The outdoor play areas directly in front of the classrooms are not ideal.

position.rationale: Play areas are approximated directly along the classroom-facing open edge.

negative.statement: The classroom organization considerably restricts usability, and flexibility between rooms, group rooms, and studio areas is impaired.

position.rationale: The classroom organization is anchored to the principal stepped wing.

negative.statement: The spatial and architectural relationship between the childcare building and classroom wing remains unclear.

position.rationale: The relationship is approximated between the visible linear wing and adjacent volume.

negative.statement: The exclusive north orientation of the classrooms is viewed critically because the canopy further reduces incoming light.

position.rationale: The north-facing edge of the classroom wing is constrained by the stated orientation.

negative.statement: The chosen spacing of the gymnasium ceiling beams seems too large, and the bracing concept is not clearly shown.

position.rationale: The gymnasium is approximated in the low embedded volume; beams are not individually distinguishable.
